program.section_heading: Early Childhood Education Certificate of Achievement- Master Teacher (COA)
outcomes: Complete the Early Childhood Education coursework to obtain a Master Teacher level permit on the Child Development Permit Matrix from the State of California Commission on Teacher Credentialing.

Apply critical thinking to research, observe, assess, evaluate, and synthesize early learning and child development information (for all children including specialized populations of children: infants and toddlers, and/or children with special needs, and/or children who have been exposed to trauma).

Utilize effective written and verbal communication techniques to ensure optimum communication with children, families, and professional colleagues (for all children including specialized populations of children: infants and toddlers, and/or children with special needs, and/or children who have been exposed to trauma)

Select, develop, and or use equipment, curriculum, assessment, materials, technology and or environments that are culturally relevant and developmentally appropriate (for all children including specialized populations of children: infants and toddlers, and/or children with special needs, and/or children who have been exposed to trauma)

notes: Catalog prints codes zero-padded without spaces (e.g., ECE001, CHDEV010); these were matched to closed-list codes ECE 1, CHDEV 10, etc., so catalog_addition is false.
The 'Major Requirements (Total 35)' heading covers the whole certificate; the 35 is recorded as total_units and the core block's stated is left null (its five courses sum to 14 units).
The three 'Select one required course below' blocks each say 'Complete the following number of credits: 3'; recorded as choose 1 course with stated 3.

Specialization blocks (Infant/Toddler, Trauma Informed Practitioner, Children With Special Needs) are recorded as one option_group: the heading says 'Choose One 6-Unit Specializations'. Core 14 + 3 x 3 + 6 = 29, which does not reach the printed 35 unless more than one specialization is taken; reviewer should check whether two specializations are required or the total is in error.

Careers list is taken from the description 'prepares students for infant and toddler programs. child care, preschool education, special education, and before and after school programs' (program settings read as career fields).
Catalog title for ECE065 reads 'Health, Safety, and Nutrition' while the state file reads 'Heath'.
